turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: Alright, let's start the Monday team meeting. First up, the HVAC class that starts on the 17th. Sam, how are employer interviews looking?

turns.speaker: Speaker 2
turns.text: Three employers have confirmed interview slots. Northside Mechanical still has two technician openings, and I need to call them back. I'll do that by Wednesday.

turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: Great. Alex, is the new enrollment form sending leads into the CRM correctly?

turns.speaker: Speaker 3
turns.text: Mostly, yes. But phone calls are still not being locked against student records. I'll open a support ticket with the phone vendor by Friday.

turns.speaker: Speaker 4
turns.text: In the plumbing class, three students still haven't finished the math placement test. I can remind them during class tomorrow. Let's decide this now. We won't

turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: start the HVAC class with fewer than eight enrolled students. Alex, please send me the enrolled student list by Thursday.

turns.speaker: Speaker 3
turns.text: Will do. I'll pull it from the CRM and email it to you Thursday morning.

turns.speaker: Speaker 2
turns.text: One more thing. Can we meet the Northside Mechanical Hiring Manager next Tuesday at 2pm? Maria, I'd like you there.

turns.speaker: Speaker 1
turns.text: Yes, let's do Tuesday at 2. Still open for next week. Whether the donor newsletter goes out before Thanksgiving. Thanks, everyone.
